description: Source code for the AudioRendererPassthrough class implementing audio rendering logic for UWP platform, including initialization, playback control, seeking, and buffer processing.

classes.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
classes.description: Class managing audio rendering, decoding, buffer processing, and playback control for UWP platform.

methods.name: CodecToIecSampleRate
methods.description: Converts media audio codec to IEC sample rate.

methods.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio renderer with decoder and stream info.

methods.name: ~AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup and logging.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder and sink, sets error and state callbacks.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input buffers to decoder for decoding.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to decoder.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets sink volume.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if EOS has been written.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamPlayed
methods.description: Checks if EOS has been played.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more data can be accepted.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets playback rate, supports only 1.0 or unsupported rates.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to specified time, resets buffers and state.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media time, playback state, and EOS status.

methods.name: OnDecoderConsumed
methods.description: Callback when decoder has consumed input.

methods.name: OnDecoderOutput
methods.description: Callback when decoder has output decoded audio.

methods.name: ProcessAudioBuffers
methods.description: Processes queued decoded audio buffers, writes to sink, handles seeking and EOS.

methods.name: TryToWriteAudioBufferToSink
methods.description: Attempts to write decoded audio buffer to sink.

methods.name: TryToEndStream
methods.description: Handles EOS output, waits for sink to finish, then signals end.

methods.name: CalculateElapsedPlaybackTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed playback time based on performance counter.

methods.name: CalculateLastOutputTime
methods.description: Calculates last output timestamp of decoded audio.
